title: Nonnegativity of the restricted iterates
statement: Let $A$ be a symmetric stochastic matrix on $	ext{Fin}(n)$, meaning that it is symmetric, has nonnegative entries, and each row sums to $1$. For every finite subset $B$ of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, every integer $k\ge 0$, and every index $j$, the $j$th coordinate of the $k$th restricted iterate is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry of A is nonnegative
Every row of A sums to one
B is a finite subset of Fin(n)
j is an index in Fin(n)
